roadmapTask: Horizon 09 of agent-agnostic-browser-bridge. Horizon 08 added an evalIsolated chrome-bridge action to read values on strict-CSP sites via an isolated-world string eval; live testing proved this impossible (MV3's extension CSP forbids eval in every world). The only route to strict-CSP value reads is CDP Runtime.evaluate, previously barred by decisions.md (h6 + h8). The user has decided to lift that ban for read-only page evaluation (and greenlight the broader CDP pivot for later horizons) and to remove the dead evalIsolated action. This horizon: remove evalIsolated, add a CDP Runtime.evaluate port, wire a new evaluatePage action end to end, and verify strict-CSP value reads in live Chrome.
